THEATRE AND FILM — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: THEATRE AND FILM
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

2. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

3. Best practice when working on Poetry writing – Spoken word: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Poetry writing – Spoken word with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Poetry writing – Spoken word.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Poetry writing – Spoken word.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Poetry writing – Spoken word.

4. Best practice when working on Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2..
   B. Refuse all feedback on Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2..
   C. Disrupt classmates during Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2..
   D. Practise Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Theatre Adjudication: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Theatre Adjudication.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Theatre Adjudication.
   C. Damage equipment used for Theatre Adjudication.
   D. Practise Theatre Adjudication with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Acting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Acting.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Acting.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Acting.
   D. Practise Acting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Introduction to Traditional Kenyan Theatre: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Introduction to Traditional Kenyan Theatre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Traditional Kenyan Theatre.
   C. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Traditional Kenyan Theatre.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Traditional Kenyan Theatre.

8. Best practice when working on Theatre Design: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Theatre Design.
   B. Practise Theatre Design with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Theatre Design.
   D. Damage equipment used for Theatre Design.

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

10. Best practice when working on Theatre and Community: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Theatre and Community.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Theatre and Community.

   D. Damage equipment used for Theatre and Community.

11. Best practice when working on Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1 Theatre Adjudication 3.2 Theatr: (1 mark)

12. Best practice when working on Theatre Adjudication 3.2 Theatre and Community Page 15 of 47 1 STRAND 1.0: CREAT: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Theatre Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Theatre Adjudication 3.2 Theatre and Community Page 15 of 47 1 STRAND 1.0: CREAT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Theatre and Community and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — The speed of the music

2. B — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

3. A — Practise Poetry writing – Spoken word with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. D — Practise Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — Practise Theatre Adjudication with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — Practise Acting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Practise Introduction to Traditional Kenyan Theatre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. B — Practise Theatre Design with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. D — Red, blue, and yellow

10. C — Practise Theatre and Community with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. A — Practise Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1 Theatre Adjudication 3.2 Theatr with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

16. (4 marks)
